boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on practical Gentilly and lakefront corridors from the seminary campus, with one documented reason to seek each out.

cards.title: See a neighboring university campus
cards.subtitle: Gentilly Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Gentilly Boulevard edge and use Dillard’s visitor information to plan a weekday campus visit or an admissions tour.
cards.short_summary: A nearby university with scheduled visitor access.
cards.evidence_claim: Dillard University lists its address at 2601 Gentilly Boulevard and says campus visits and tours are available by appointment.
cards.access_notes: Visitor tours require an appointment; see Dillard’s visit page for current scheduling and closure details.

cards.title: Locate a public-library branch
cards.subtitle: Gentilly Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or a device and check the branch’s current calendar and hours before heading to 3001 Gentilly Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A named New Orleans Public Library branch in Gentilly.
cards.evidence_claim: New Orleans Public Library identifies Norman Mayer Library at 3001 Gentilly Boulevard, New Orleans.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s live listing for current hours and services.

cards.title: Spot a long-running Gentilly school
cards.subtitle: Elysian Fields Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Elysian Fields Avenue to identify Brother Martin’s campus, then rely on the school for any public-event or visitor details.
cards.short_summary: A named secondary-school campus on Elysian Fields.
cards.evidence_claim: The Archdiocese of New Orleans lists Brother Martin High School at 4401 Elysian Fields Avenue in New Orleans.
cards.source_title: Archdiocese of New Orleans School Finder
cards.access_notes: This is an operating school; do not enter campus except for an authorized event or appointment.

cards.title: Check the recreation-center schedule
cards.subtitle: Franklin Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Look for NORD programming at Milne and confirm registration, age range, and session details before making the Franklin Avenue trip.
cards.short_summary: A city recreation-center destination on Franklin Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: NORD’s 2026 summer-camp listing identifies NORD at Milne Recreation Center at 5420 Franklin Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Programs and eligibility vary; verify the current NORD schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Find SUNO’s campus corridor
cards.subtitle: SUNO Knights Drive / Press Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the SUNO contact page to orient to the campus and its weekday office hours before arranging any campus-related errand.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public university campus with listed office hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Southern University at New Orleans lists its address as 6400 SUNO Knights Drive and office hours Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Contact Us | Southern University at New Orleans
cards.access_notes: Administrative office hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm visitor access separately.

cards.title: Head toward the Lakefront campus
cards.subtitle: Lakeshore Drive corridor
cards.notes: Follow the lakeside route to UNO’s University Center and use the Ask Lafitte Information Desk as a clear on-campus orientation point.
cards.short_summary: A lakefront university destination with a public information desk.
cards.evidence_claim: UNO lists the University Center at 2000 Lakeshore Drive and identifies the Ask Lafitte Information Desk in the UC Lobby.
cards.access_notes: Check UNO’s visitor and building-access guidance before entering campus facilities.

cards.title: Check the arena calendar
cards.subtitle: Franklin Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the venue’s event listing to see what is scheduled at Lakefront Arena, then choose a ticketed or public event that fits your plans.
cards.short_summary: A named performance and event venue at the lakefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Ticketmaster lists Lakefront Arena at 6801 Franklin Avenue in New Orleans and provides its event schedule.
cards.source_title: Lakefront Arena Events and Venue Details
cards.access_notes: Entry and ticket requirements depend on the individual event.

cards.title: See the lakefront airport terminal
cards.subtitle: Stars and Stripes Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the airport’s contact information to identify the terminal and check its visitor guidance before making a daytime aviation-focused stop.
cards.short_summary: A named lakefront airport terminal with public contact information.
cards.evidence_claim: New Orleans Lakefront Airport lists its main office at 6001 Stars & Stripes Boulevard and states that the airport operates 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: The airport states it operates 24 hours daily; terminal and airfield access remain subject to airport rules.

cards.title: Use a major city park address
cards.subtitle: Read Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daylight park visit around the Read Boulevard entrance and check city recreation notices for any facility-specific programming.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed park destination in eastern Gentilly.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of New Orleans parks-and-greenspace inventory lists Joe Brown Park at 5601 Read Boulevard and Lake Forest.
cards.source_title: City of New Orleans Parks and Greenspace by Jurisdiction
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access and recreation programming can change with weather and city operations.

cards.title: Find a city playground site
cards.subtitle: Lapeyrouse Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the named playground as a neighborhood recreation waypoint and check NORD materials for current activities or facility access before going.
cards.short_summary: A city-documented playground site in Gentilly.
cards.evidence_claim: A New Orleans City Council record identifies Stallings-Gentilly Playground at 2700 Lapeyrouse Street, New Orleans.
cards.access_notes: Verify current NORD programming and site conditions before visiting.
